content.text: Nambana imambu dokome Kamongo doko lakandarowale.
Nambana yongope suu pingi imambupi peparaeme banya kingi poo pyasi doko lakandarowale.
Baa anjiki pingi doko kame soo kaeya nao
nambana imambu dokome Kamongo baa lakandaro.
Baame nambana koo dupwa peparae nyuo anamasi minyuo
baame nambana anga yakane peparae pyuo lete nyuo mee ingingi.
Baame nambamalu anda pasarene lao minyaro karenge.
Baame sakame kumapala mona reto nyisingi.
Baame bange keyange renge dupwa namba keta palyuo simbwange.
Dokona namba enenge ingyuo karo yaka kambe yongo nyuo kararo.
Kamongome mondo lao yapalyuo wambu koo keta palyuo isingi dupwana lao rolo
nakama nyelana pyuo karenge dokoko maingi.
Baame yulu lao masiyamo dusipa Mosese keta paneya.
Dopa pyuo Isaraele wambu dupwame banya yulu porai dupwa kandena lao piya.
Kamongo doko baame sakame kumuo mona reto pingi.
Baa waiya lao imbwa nao mona reto puupenge.
Renge doko baa keta palyuo pyoko pyoko lenge.
Baame lao nembo pyalana pyuo karalu karo pii nange.
Baa imbu singi nyuo karalu kara nange.
Namwa randa nyeramali dokona baame randa jii nange.
Namwana koo kyai pyuo pingi dupwana yano nyeramali dokona yano pyara nange.
Wambumi baa ketae pyambungi dupwa keta banya mona retenge renge doko
isa yuu dakena piso yake sungange dopale ingyuo mona retenge.
Neta epenge dokona piso pao neta yalyingi doko londesa dopale
baame namwana koo dupwa nyuo kame soo nyuo nembakange.
Rakangeme banya ikinyingi kando yako yako lao anjiki pinginyili pyuo
Kamongome wambu baa ketae pyambungi dupwa pipya anjiki pingi.
Baamenamwa akimi wasisi karaminyi lao soo karamo.
Namwa sinjimu dokome wasisikande lao soo karamo.
Akali doko banya lete karene doko isoko dopakale.
Baa ando karo epaleta isa jingi apu epelyamo dokopa elyape ingyuo lyuo panyi pilyamo dokopa loo lao pingi dopale.
Enakana porambaiye dokona minyilyamo dokopa soo neta penge.
Mendeme dee kamba silyamo kanda nange.
Dopa pyuo pelyamopape wambu baa kingi ketaepyambuo lakandaraminyi dupwa
Kamongona mona retenge doko nakama keta sulu soo singi.
Banya kana minyuo lalu lao lenge doko minyaro karengepe
dee banya mawa pii yaki nyii nao rape rape lao minyingipi dupwana para pyao nyerami dupwa keta
banya keyange renge soo puu pao penge.
Kamongome baa yake panda dokona kiŋi ingyuo pisipala
wambu peparae rapu pyuo karamo.
Nakama aŋala porai
banya mawa pii rape rape lao piraminyi dupwape
baa laramopii doko waa lao kale yukupala soo pisiraminyi dupwapeme
Kamongo doko lakandarami.
Nakama yake dokona karenge banya kendemande dupwa
baame pimili lao suu pyapyamo pilyaminyi dupwame Kamongo doko lakandarami.
Yuu baame isilyamo dupwa peparaena kata papingi bange peparae Kamongo wasiyamo dupwame
baa lakandarami.
Dopako pyuo namba Kamongodoko lakandarowale.
